outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental design, not a quantitative plot.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b expression shows individual data points (dots) overlaid on each bar in addition to the mean ± SD.
Tumor volume data are displayed as a scatter plot with each mouse's tumor volume shown as an individual point, with mean and 95% CI overlaid.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b shRNA expression shows individual data points overlaid on each bar in addition to the mean ± SD.
This is a line plot of tumor volume over time; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays as this would make the plot unreadable.
The CD4 quantification bar chart shows individual data points (dots) for each field/tumor overlaid on the bars along with mean ± SD.
The pERK quantification bar chart shows individual data points (dots) for each field overlaid on the bars along with mean ± SD.
